description: This file manages WiFi network name configurations within a GUI application. It includes functions for fetching, updating, validating, and applying SSID and PassPhrase settings for different WiFi 'haul' types, utilizing C interop for certain network operations, and providing a Fyne-based dialog interface for user interaction.

classes.name: HaulConfig
classes.description: Data structure to hold haul type, SSID, and PassPhrase.

methods.name: getConfiguredHauls
methods.description: Extracts WiFi haul configurations from a network tree.

methods.name: updateSSIDPassForHaulType
methods.description: Updates SSID and PassPhrase for a specified haul type within the network tree.

methods.name: updateNodeValue
methods.description: Helper to safely update node string values.

methods.name: validateSSID
methods.description: Validates the SSID based on length and allowed characters.

methods.name: validatePassPhrase
methods.description: Validates the PassPhrase based on length constraints.

methods.name: applyNetworkNameConfig
methods.description: Applies the new SSID configuration by executing a set command.
